invariants.rationale: The method always returns HoodieListData.eager(data), which constructs and returns a HoodieData instance, so result is never null.
HoodieListData.eager(data) wraps the provided list, so collecting from result should yield the original list.
A parallelism of less than 1 would be nonsensical for parallelizing data; typical usage and contracts require parallelism >= 1.
The returned HoodieData contains exactly the elements of the input list, so their sizes match.
